name: EXEC
description: Run a command synchronously and return its stdout. Use for one-shot commands (reading files, listing directories, etc).

name: SPAWN
description: Start a long-running process. Returns its PID. The process gets TABULA_SOCKET env var and can connect to the kernel.

name: KILL
description: Stop a running process by PID.

name: LIST
description: List all spawned processes with PID, command, and alive status.
